note: Export side is factually confirmed: dated air-cargo export bills of lading from Sahar Air Cargo ACC (Mumbai) to Russia, Brazil and Denmark, Feb 2026, with HS codes and BOL numbers — this is a real, active exporter of steroid/API bulk drugs, not a claim. Declared HS 294200 is broadly consistent with the observed 29420090 rows, though actual shipments also run under 29372900 (steroid hormones), so the working HS should be treated as 29420090/29372900 depending on product. Import side also confirmed (e.g. 2026-02-18 Zhejiang Top Hankook Biopharm -> Nhava Sheva, trimethyl orthoformate, HS 29159099, BOL 7606254), i.e. the company is a manufacturer_trader-style API operation importing intermediates and re-exporting finished bulk drugs. Domestic supply evidence NOT established: GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report splits could not be retrieved — zaubacorp and thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403, and the search backend was unavailable (connection refused) for all queries, so no domestic record was seen. Per rule 5 this is recorded as unknown, not as confirmed; absence of retrieved evidence is not evidence of absence. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in the sources read, not estimated. No rejection grounds: the entity is active in customs data as of 2026-02-27.
